data.narrative:
Breaker Industries is a seed-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $6M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public and 8 private—operating in the same sector and stage. Key private comparables include UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic; public peers trade under tickers DRSHF and IDEAFORGE.NS.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The Stage-Progression method, using the $6M total raised as a proxy for post-money seed valuation and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage progression, implies a valuation of $15M. The Peer-Median method examines four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (Stark Defence at $4.0B Series A, UFORCE at $1.0B Seed, Singularity at $400M Series A, and NODA AI at $125M Series A), yielding a median valuation of $700M with a range of $125M to $4.0B.

The triangulated analysis across both methods supports a valuation range of $13M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $358M. The extreme spread reflects material dispersion in the peer set, particularly between seed-stage and Series A comparables. Key uncertainties include whether UFORCE at $1.0B is representative of Breaker's growth trajectory, stage-specific valuation methodology applicability, and comparable company selection bias within the emerging Defense & Security subsector.
